failedAssertions.reason: Three of the seven actions (Import Repo, Upload Bundle, Review Builds) overscrolled past their intended target after switching from All to Pipeline, so the destination panel was not left in the viewport.
The corrected local source build serves /billing, but only as a Coming Soon placeholder rather than the required loading/empty/error shells.
The corrected local source build serves /monitoring, but only as a Coming Soon placeholder rather than the required loading/empty/error shells.

appliedUpdates.description: Corrected janus-web service management to use a detached local npm run start process with port-based stop semantics, because cached container images were stale and container rebuilds currently fail on npm ci peer dependency resolution.

Documented frontend-hardening concurrency guidance and the local-source frontend validation path after confirming the cached janus-web container missed current routes such as /billing and /monitoring.
